video_title: Jaylen Brown reveals he is cousins with AJ Brown & trade still feels weird

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the strange feeling of being traded
quotes.excerpt: I got no idea what it's going to feel like. It's probably going to feel a bit weird.
quotes.quote: I got no idea what it's going to feel like. It's probably going to feel a bit weird. It's still weird now. My brain is like, Philly? Like, of all places? Like, why would you do that?

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown affirms his long-term commitment to Boston
quotes.excerpt: Boston is home. No management or organization will take that away.
quotes.quote: It's okay, things happen. But I love the city of Boston. I always have. I've been here for 10 years, a third of my life. I'll be 30 in October, so Boston is home. No management or organization will take that away.
